prompt:

Steven woke up at 9am.
Leslie saw Steven buying lunch at the deli from 9am to 12pm.
Jason saw Steven stretching at a yoga studio from 12pm to 1pm.
James saw Steven driving to the water park from 4pm to 5pm.
Nancy saw Steven attending class at the school from 5pm to 7pm.
The clothing store was closed after 7pm.
Between what times could Steven have gone to the clothing store?

Options:
(A) 4pm to 5pm
(B) 9am to 12pm
(C) 1pm to 4pm
(D) 12pm to 1pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)

- Steven was busy from 9am to 12pm.
- From 12pm to 1pm, he was at the yoga studio.
- From 4pm to 5pm, he was driving to the water park.
- From 5pm to 7pm, he was attending class.

The only time slot not occupied by any of these activities is between 1pm and 4pm. This is the only period when Steven was not engaged in any of the activities listed, and it falls within the store's operating hours.
